component.name: OwlMusic
component.summary: Local music player with lyrics and tag editing
本地音乐播放器，支持歌词同步与标签编辑

description.p: OwlMusic is a lightweight local music player for GNOME / Ubuntu, written in Rust with GTK4.

ul.li: Playlist on the left, synced lyrics on the right with blurred album-art background
Read and write tags (title, artist, album, genre, year, cover, embedded lyrics)
Online metadata and lyrics lookup via iTunes Search and LRCLIB
Customisable lyric size, colour, alignment and background blur
